title: South Korea recalls its envoy to Ukraine over prisoner-of-war row
note: Seoul is recalling its ambassador to Kyiv after Ukraine disclosed that two North Korean prisoners were transferred to South Korea. The dispute strains ties between two governments on opposite sides of the North Korea-Russia military link.

title: Most UK diplomats to leave East Jerusalem consulate, Israel says
note: Israel says most British diplomats must leave the UK consulate in East Jerusalem, after it said in September that it would respond to UK sanctions on illegal settlements in the West Bank. The UK foreign secretary says vital services will remain.
limitations: The scope of the restrictions and the number of staff affected come from the Israeli statement and are not independently confirmed. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Security Council votes on renewing Sudan sanctions and arms embargo
note: The UN Security Council is scheduled to vote on a draft resolution renewing the Sudan sanctions regime, which includes an arms embargo and targeted travel bans and asset freezes focused on Darfur. The current regime expires on 9 October 2026.
limitations: The source is a meeting notice published before the vote, so the outcome is not reported. Drafted by an automated daily job from the linked report; not yet reviewed.

title: Developing countries paid almost a trillion dollars in net debt interest
note: UN Trade and Development warns that developing countries paid almost a trillion dollars in net interest on public debt last year, nearly three times the 2010 level. The burden leaves less for health, education and other priorities, which can add to state fragility.

title: Israeli demolition in East Jerusalem displaces 69 Palestinians
note: The UN aid coordination office reports that 69 Palestinians, more than half of them children, were displaced after Israeli authorities approved demolition of their residential building in the At Tur area. Such demolitions feed friction over contested land in occupied East Jerusalem.
